blockingFindings.title: Missing no-audit assertion for blocked broad review
blockingFindings.rationale: This is an explicit acceptance requirement with no executable assertion, and the missing assertion would allow the forbidden audited broad-mode behavior to pass.
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires the currentTaskId=null/actionable-work path to fail before subprocess launch without creating an audited broad-mode record. The test only asserts ok:false and zero subprocess calls, so an implementation could incorrectly append broadModeHistory or otherwise create broad-mode audit metadata before returning failure and this test would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: In the no-broad R6 case, snapshot the flow state before execute and assert no broad-mode record or other durable audit state was added, at minimum that broadModeHistory remains unchanged/empty after the failed run.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is an explicit acceptance requirement with no executable assertion, and the missing assertion would allow the forbidden audited broad-mode behavior to pass.
